questionEn: Which rationale on the topic “Simple and complex substances” is chemically correct?
questionUz: “Oddiy va murakkab moddalar” mavzusidagi qaysi asos kimyoviy jihatdan to‘g‘ri?
choicesEn: changes in the shape of an element that differs from each other in physical and chemical properties
substances consisting of atoms of the same element
substances consisting of atoms of various elements
the phenomenon of the formation of several simple substances from one chemical element
choicesUz: fizik va kimyoviy xossalari bilan bir-biridan farq qiluvchi element shaklining o'zgarishi
bir xil element atomlaridan tashkil topgan moddalar
turli elementlarning atomlaridan tashkil topgan moddalar
bir kimyoviy elementdan bir nechta oddiy moddalar hosil bo'lish hodisasi
explanationEn: Allotropic modifications are changes in the shape of an element that differs from each other in physical and chemical properties.
explanationUz: Allotropik modifikatsiyalar - fizik va kimyoviy xossalari bilan bir-biridan farq qiladigan element shaklidagi o'zgarishlar.
